resources.string: Randomize Snooze and Stop for each occurrence; keep their positions stable while it rings.
Snooze when the full-screen alert receives a volume key, including over the lock screen. Unavailable if the system intercepts the key.
Snooze when the power key turns the screen off

Snooze when the device goes to sleep during ringing. Android does not deliver power-key events; automatic sleep may also trigger this. Pressing power on an already sleeping device is not guaranteed to snooze.

Alarms, countdowns and Pomodoro share these settings. Allow notifications, exact alarms and full-screen alerts, and keep the alert channel at high importance. While using the phone, Android may show a banner instead.
HyperOS / MIUI: if lock-screen alerts are blocked, check Show on Lock screen, background pop-up windows, autostart and background battery limits in system app settings. Names vary by OS version.

ColorOS / OnePlus / realme: if alerts are delayed or hidden on the lock screen, check lock-screen notifications, background activity and autostart in system app settings. Options depend on the OS version.
Android full-screen notifications and back gestures take priority. If the OS does not supply predictive back progress, ordinary Back remains available but a gesture preview cannot be guaranteed.
